name: Comms dish on a turntable
brief: MK-005 Comms dish on a turntable. A 3.2 m dish on a yoke, a feed horn on three struts, a counterweight and a red blinker. It turns to follow Earth; when it is talking to home its feed lamp glows and the turntable hums.

rounds.t: First build from the pack style and the Faceted Hero rules, no Midjourney pick yet.
